html:
The Colorado River is a river of the south western United States and north west Mexico, about 2,300 kilometres long, running from the Rocky Mountains to the Gulf of California. Over millions of years it carved the Grand Canyon.

Its lower valley, hot and dry but flooded each spring, was farmed by Yuman-speaking peoples who planted maize, beans and squash in the river mud: the Mojave, the Quechan and, further south, the Cocopah and the Kamia. In a side canyon of the Grand Canyon the Havasupai have farmed for centuries.

Spanish explorers reached it in 1540, both from the sea and overland to the rim of the Grand Canyon. John Wesley Powell led the first known boat trip through the canyon in 1869. In the 1900s the river was tamed for water and power. A compact of 1922 split its water among seven US states, and Hoover Dam, finished in 1936, was the first of the great dams on it. Its water now irrigates farms and supplies cities from Denver to Los Angeles, and in most years the river no longer reaches the sea.
sum: The Colorado River is a river of the south western United States and north west Mexico, about 2,300 kilometres long, running from the Rocky Mountains to the Gulf of California. Over millions of years it carved the Grand Canyon.
